author: WroclawTheGame project / original procedural authoring
reference_policy: Architecture viewing only. No photographs downloaded, embedded or redistributed.
fidelity: Generic architectural enrichment, not measured reconstruction of a specific building.
axis_convention: Blender metres; X along facade, +Y outward, Z up; pipeline centers XY and puts base at Z=0.
collision_policy: Railing has three authored UCX guard panels with an open back and central space; balcony slab has one convex collision. Portal/cornice/door trim is decorative without collision. Existing building openings and interactions remain authoritative.
textures: Original deterministic 1024x1024 iron PBR maps; stone uses acquired Poly Haven CC0 Sandstone Cracks by Rob Tuytel, recorded in Data/city_asset_acquisition.json. Original stone source maps retained as fallback.
door_materials: Original colored source materials; native door binds existing versioned project MI_Wood, MI_Metal and MI_Glass. Decorative static door, not a new usable interior.
